title: IYOVIA World Summit 2025: The Ultimate Leadership & Business Development Experience for IBOs | User | ridgwayrecord.com
text:
Strengthen Your Leadership. Expand Your Network. Elevate Your Skills. For the first time ever, IYOVIA’s World Summit is coming to Europe! This live event is designed for IYOVIA Independent Business Owners (IBOs) — giving you access to leadership training, business development insights, and networking opportunities to support your personal and professional growth.
Location: Palais Nikaïa, Nice, France
Dates: May 30 – June 1, 2025
Who: Anyone Age 18+
Why Every IYOVIA IBO Should Attend
Learn Leadership & Business Development Strategies
Gain insights from experienced professionals and educators on topics tailored specifically for IYOVIA IBOs :
Strategic Business Growth – Learn methods that may help you expand your customer base and develop sustainable business practices.
Personal Branding & Influence – Discover ways to position yourself effectively in the digital space.
Advanced Market Insights – Stay ahead with discussions on emerging trends, fintech, and digital entrepreneurship.
Network & Collaborate with IYOVIA’s Global Community
This summit provides an opportunity for IBOs to connect with fellow entrepreneurs, industry professionals, and educators.
Build relationships with high-level IYOVIA IBOs
Gain mentorship insights from proven leaders
Exchange ideas, collaborate, and expand your professional network
Get an Exclusive First Look at IYOVIA’s Latest Innovations
As an IYOVIA IBO, staying ahead of industry developments is key. At this event, you'll be among the first to explore upcoming IYOVIA tools and resources, including:
IYOVIA AI – A learning tool designed to support IBOs in enhancing communication and business skills.
IYOVIA LIFE – A new wellness initiative supporting a balanced entrepreneurial lifestyle.
Note: Product announcements are for informational purposes only. No purchase is necessary to attend or participate.
A Destination That Inspires
Nice, France, provides the perfect setting to refresh your mindset, engage with industry leaders, and take part in a unique learning experience.
Inspiring coastal views to elevate your mindset
A vibrant hub of innovation to fuel creativity
Networking opportunities in a collaborative and engaging atmosphere
Scenic Mediterranean sunsets to close each day with inspiration
Event Ticket Details
General Admission – €199
Full access to all IBO leadership & business development sessions
Entry to goLIVE Training Day (Day 1)
Participation in Product Demonstration & Strategy Sessions (Day 2)
Access to IBO Leadership & Recognition Day (Day 3)
Official event app access for exclusive updates
VIP Executive Pass – €299
Everything in General Admission, PLUS:
Priority check-in for a seamless arrival
Early access to the venue each day
Exclusive VIP backstage tour
Media Pass – €499 (Approval Required)
Credentials for content creation at all sessions, keynotes, and panels
Special Media Badge for easy identification
Access to the event app for real-time updates
Note: Media passes require approval. Apply at iyovia.events.
Want to Attend For Free?
Earn event discounts by referring others to register:
2 referrals = 10% off
5 referrals = 30% off
8 referrals = FREE ticket
Disclosure: Participation in the referral program is optional. Discounts and free entry are based on successful referrals. Full terms & conditions apply at iyovia.events.
Secure Your Spot Today!
Spaces are limited, and this event is expected to sell out. Reserve your spot now and embark on your journey to personal and professional growth!
Register at: iyovia.events
Note: IYOVIA provides online educational services and does not offer financial, investment, or advisory services. No results or income are guaranteed. This event is for educational and networking purposes only. Full terms & conditions apply — visit iyovia.events for details.

Email: Send Email
Country: United States
